svg.title: Bar chart showing WELLBYs created per $1,000 donated across charity groups. Top 5 LMIC charities (54.92) are 66 times more cost-effective than UK charities (0.83). Pure Earth (Ghana) (105.43) is 916 times more cost-effective than the least cost-effective evaluated charity, Football Beyond Borders (0.12).
